subject: Practical prompt lab onboarding & traffic validation

From: Elena Rossi <elena@kythera.ai>

Cc: Samir Patel <samir@kythera.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0500
Subject: POC kickoff — prompt review, routing & traffic validation

Hi Tessa / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Kythera team is keen to convert the evaluation into a short PoC so we can validate latency and routing behavior against our ingestion bursts. High-level goals for the PoC: prompt inventory and mapping to intents, guardrails & structured outputs (we have a few JSON schemas), routing fallbacks for sensitive queries, and an end-to-end traffic validation (load) run to estimate unit cost.

Can we lock a 3-hour hands-on session in the first full week of December? Preferably Dec 8 or 9 (US Eastern). Attendees from our side: myself (Head of ML), Samir (SRE lead), and two engineers who will run the load tests. I attached our current prompt inventory export (prompt_inventory_kythera.csv) to this thread — it's a bit messy but should help scope.

Questions for you:
- Can Redwood run a short smoke load test ahead of the session so the team sees end-to-end traces?
- Any recommended pre-reads or templates we should fill out?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Regards,
Elena Rossi
Head of ML, Kythera AI
elena@kythera.ai
Attachment: prompt_inventory_kythera.csv (CSV)

Subject: Re: POC kickoff — prompt review, routing & traffic validation

Hi Elena — great to hear, and thanks for the inventory export.

We can absolutely run a short smoke load ahead of the hands-on session to validate KV cache behavior and routing fallbacks. Proposed plan:
1) 30m pre-check (Redwood SEs run smoke load against a sandbox endpoint)
2) 3h hands-on lab (prompt inventory walkthrough, guardrails & structured-output mapping, routing policies)
3) 30–45m live traffic validation with Kythera traces and a recommended batching/quantization profile.

Schedule options (ET):
- Tue Dec 8, 09:30–13:00
- Wed Dec 9, 10:00–13:30

Please confirm which day works best and who the final attendees will be. I attached a short agenda and a prompt-inventory template that we ask customers to fill out for mapping outputs. Also linking the draft agenda: https://redwood.example.com/drive/kythera-poc-agenda

Action items for Kythera before the session:
- Share sample prompt outputs and JSON schemas for structured outputs
- Provide a sample traffic trace or a short script to reproduce burst patterns

Ben will lead the smoke load; Karthik will own runtime and quantization questions; Marissa will run the rollout/analytics demo.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.ai

Elena — quick note from the infra side:

For the smoke load I mentioned, could you also share an anonymized sample of payload sizes (tokens per request) and the percent of long-running conversations that use KV cache? That will help me size batch windows and recommend a quantization profile so we can get realistic latency/cost numbers during the traffic validation. If you prefer, Samir can upload a small gzipped trace to the shared drive.

I'll stand up the sandbox and coordinate with Karthik on model variant fallbacks (we should exercise an L2 fallback during the run).
